scores.evidence: The s2-layers flowchart TD fits 390 px with readable Japanese labels (mobile-jp-06/07). The two-column tables s2-table and s5-table wrap cleanly with nothing cut off (mobile-jp-07, mobile-jp-13/14). Every code block (s3-code, practice-case-settings, practice-case-zshrc, practice-folder, practice-answer-rule) shows in full without sideways scrolling.

No screen is text-only (textOnlyScreens is empty on both devices), and the concept sections alternate prose, definitions, a diagram, tables and checks. The practice section is long on mobile (mobile-jp-15 to mobile-jp-20). It uses three separate one-step steps blocks, and each one restarts at '1' with '1ステップ中 0 完了'.

All learner-facing text is Japanese, as is everything in the reader UI and the diagram labels. English appears only in terms glossed on first use, such as 'プロンプトインジェクション（prompt injection）', and in code. Text contrast is good on the warning and pitfall callouts (s1-auto, s3-pitfall). No awkward line breaks inside Japanese words were seen.

niceToHave: practice-steps / practice-steps-deny / practice-steps-bill: three one-step steps blocks each show the number '1' and '1ステップ中 0 完了' (mobile-jp-16, mobile-jp-18, desktop-jp-11, desktop-jp-13). That reads like three separate procedures. Merge them into one 3-step steps block where the code and prompt blocks in between allow it, or give each block a title that tells them apart.
reader: desktop-jp charsPerLine median is 44 (max 56) against the 30–40 JP target at a 680 px measure. The lesson can't fix this; narrowing the reader's text column would.
reader: inline code wraps mid-token on mobile, e.g. 'claude -' / 'p' in the e5 prompt and '-' / 'p' in option 4 (mobile-jp-24). This is known reader behaviour.
reader: the end banner says this is the course's last lesson (mobile-jp-28, desktop-jp-19). This happens because drafts are not in course.json.
reader: the mobile full-length PNG is truncated at 16000px (truncated: true). All 28 per-screen PNGs were reviewed instead.
summary: I checked the screenshots of lesson hash sha256:4f85040f9e462bb2 (it matches the expected hash). metrics.json shows no hard failures: no overflow, no console, mermaid or unknown-block errors, and no broken images. The diagram, both tables and all code blocks are fully readable at 390 px. No personal data is on any screen: the zshrc example uses a placeholder key. The only suggestion is optional: merge the three one-step practice steps blocks so the repeated '1' numbering doesn't read as three separate procedures.
